source: OSRS Wiki: {{LocLine}} and the map of the articles Dark wizard, Undead tree, Vine (Draynor Manor), Jail guard (checked 2026-09-27)

zones.name: Dark Wizards Circle
zones.message: DANGER: the level 7 and 20 dark wizards at the stone circle south of Varrock attack on their own and hit with magic. Stay away from the circle.
zones.hud: Dark wizard zone! Stay away from the circle.
zones.source: Dark wizard: LocLine "Varrock stone circle", 11 points 3223-3232 x 3363-3374; aggressive = Yes

zones.name: Dark Wizards behind Draynor bank
zones.message: Careful: level 7 dark wizards stand behind the Draynor bank and attack on their own. The shrimp fishing spot is nearby, fish further south.
zones.hud: Dark wizards behind the Draynor bank.
zones.source: Dark wizard: LocLine "Behind Draynor Village bank", 3084,3236 and 3085,3238

zones.name: Draynor Manor Undead Trees
zones.message: DANGER: in the Draynor Manor yard the animated trees hit anyone passing by, and invisible vines at the south-east corner sting every 3 seconds. Do not run straight across the yard.
zones.source: Undead tree: the article map, 10 points of the yard 3103-3122 x 3335-3348; Vine (Draynor Manor): 3118,3342, r=7

zones.name: Draynor Jail Guards
zones.message: Careful: the level 26 jail guards by Draynor Jail are aggressive and chase you along the road. Stay away from the jail.
zones.source: Jail guard: LocLine "Draynor Village jail", 3109-3127 x 3237-3249; aggressive2-4 = Yes

zones.name: Elvarg's lair
zones.message: DANGER: Elvarg (level 83) breathes fire that hits up to 70 without an Anti-dragon shield. Wear the shield before you go in and keep it on.
zones.hud: Equip the Anti-dragon shield! Elvarg's fire hits up to 70.
zones.source: Quest Helper Dragon Slayer I: enterElvargArea 2846,9635 and killElvarg 2855,9637; shield from the OSRS Wiki article Elvarg

zones.name: Lady Lumbridge at Port Sarim
zones.message: Do not sail to Crandor without the Anti-dragon shield: Elvarg waits at the end of the trip. Take it from Duke Horacio in Lumbridge Castle first.
zones.hud: Take the Anti-dragon shield before boarding!
zones.source: Quest Helper Dragon Slayer I: boardShipToGo 3047,3205 with the anti-dragon shield as a requirement

zones.name: Melzar's lesser demon
zones.message: The lesser demon (level 82) behind the magenta door hits hard. Safespot it with ranged or magic from the spot east of the magenta door.
zones.hud: Lesser demon (level 82): safespot it from the east of the magenta door.
zones.source: Quest Helper Dragon Slayer I: killLesserDemon 2936,9652 (safespottable)

zones.name: Draynor Manor: no Stake
zones.message: Count Draynor cannot be killed without a Stake. Dr. Harlow in the Blue Moon Inn gives one for a beer.
zones.hud: Take a Stake for Count Draynor!
zones.source: Quest Helper Vampyre Slayer: enterDraynorManor 3108,3353; the stake and the hammer are required for Count Draynor, garlic weakens him

zones.name: Draynor Manor: no Hammer
zones.message: You need a Hammer to drive the Stake into Count Draynor. The Lumbridge General Store sells one for 1 gp.
zones.hud: Take a Hammer for Count Draynor!
zones.source: Quest Helper Vampyre Slayer: enterDraynorManor 3108,3353; the stake and the hammer are required for Count Draynor, garlic weakens him

zones.name: Draynor Manor: no Garlic
zones.message: Garlic in the bag weakens Count Draynor (level 34). It is in the cupboard upstairs in Morgan's house.
zones.hud: Garlic in the bag weakens Count Draynor.
zones.source: Quest Helper Vampyre Slayer: enterDraynorManor 3108,3353; the stake and the hammer are required for Count Draynor, garlic weakens him
